suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-7 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Acute hepatitis as a recognized clinical manifestation of acute Q fever. Require clinically established acute Q fever using appropriate Coxiella burnetii diagnostic evidence and separately established acute hepatitis with compatible timing. Do not generalize this edge to chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis, or an isolated nonspecific liver-enzyme elevation without a compatible acute Q-fever syndrome. Preserve viral hepatitis, alcohol-associated liver disease, metabolic liver disease, autoimmune hepatitis, drug- or toxin-induced injury, ischemic injury, biliary disease, and other hepatic causes. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
